name: Colors & Presiding Deities Reference
note: Per-planet favorable colors and the deity traditionally associated with its worship - the lightest-weight of all the Upaya categories here (no purchase, no ritual precision required). Same non-prescriptive framing as gemstones.json.

verification_pass.method: Per-planet correspondences cross-checked against multiple classical/reference sources for consistency - these are widely standardized associations across Vedic astrology texts with little cross-source disagreement, unlike e.g. Pitra Dosha's definition.

user_review_pass.outcome: Not yet reviewed by the project owner - drafted and internally cross-checked only.

generated_by: Claude (Cowork) - drafted from training knowledge, cross-checked for internal consistency

items.title: Sun — Colors & Deity
items.summary: Favorable colors and presiding deity traditionally associated with Sun.
items.effects: Wearing or favoring red, orange, copper on Sun's day, and worship directed to Surya, are both traditionally used as lighter-weight alternatives or complements to gemstones/yantras for supporting Sun's themes.
